```{r}
#| include: false
 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = TRUE
  , message = FALSE
)

# improve digit and NA display 
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(hms)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(gganimate)
library(gifski)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}

fatalstormdata <- read.csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")

fatalstormcount <- read.csv("../data/stormcount.csv")

stormdetails <- read.csv("../data/storm_details.csv")

```


```{r}

#put this into wrangling file and then i can delete the storm_details thing
allstormcount0 <- stormdetails |>
  select(YEAR, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  unite(storm, YEAR, EVENT_TYPE, sep = ",") |>
  count(storm) |>
  separate(storm, into = c("YEAR", "EVENT_TYPE"), sep = ",") 
allstormcount <- allstormcount0 |>
  mutate(YEAR = as.integer(allstormcount0$YEAR))

```



```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10}

#limiting event type categories
stormbar <- fatalstormcount |>
  mutate(lesstypes = fct_collapse(EVENT_TYPE,
                                  Floods = c("Flood", "Flash Flood"),
                                  Winds = c("Thunderstorm Wind", 
                                            "Marine Thunderstorm Wind", 
                                            "Marine Strong Wind", 
                                            "Marine High Wind"),
                                  Lightning = c("Lightning", "Marine Lightning"),
                                  Other = c("Waterspout", "Dust Devil", "Debris Flow", "Funnel Cloud")))
  

#counting up the total number of storms/fatal storms per
#year for both datasets 
yearlystormtotal <- allstormcount |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n))

yearlyfataltotal <- fatalstormcount |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n))

#proportion of total storms that caused fatalities
propfatal <- yearlystormtotal |>
  inner_join(yearlyfataltotal, by = join_by(YEAR == YEAR)) |>
  #n.y is number of fatal storms in a year
  #n.x is number of total storms in a year
  mutate(prop = n.y/n.x)


gfatal <- ggplot(stormbar, aes(x = YEAR, y = n, fill = lesstypes)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, option = "A") +
  labs(
    title = "Amount of storms causing fatalities",
    x = "",
    y = "# of storms",
    fill = "Type of storm",
    caption = "Note the difference in scale between total storms and fatal storms."
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  #resizing legend and caption
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 12)) +
  #adding annotation to clarify relationship btwn graphs
  annotate("text", x = 1986, y = 190,
           label = "In 2011, there were 79,091 storm/weather events.\n269 (or ~0.34%) of those caused fatalities.",
           size = 4.5) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2003, y = 210, xend = 2010.5, yend = 250)
  

gprop <- ggplot(propfatal, aes(x = YEAR , y = prop)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of storms causing fatalities",
    x = "Year",
    y = "%") +
  #changing y axis to show as percentages
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  theme_classic()

gtotal <- ggplot(yearlystormtotal, aes(x = YEAR, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Total number of storms",
    x = "",
    y = "# of storms"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
  
#using patchwork package to lay out all 3 plots as one 
gtotal / gfatal / gprop +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 4, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Storms in the United States",
    subtitle = "1950-2026, NOAA\n",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), 
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15))
  ) 


```
